WFAM.Title: WFRP 4e Automated Miscasts
WFAM.Settings.Enabled.Name: Post miscasts as draggable items
WFAM.Settings.Enabled.Hint: When a miscast table is rolled (from a casting or channelling card, an @Table link or /table), post the result as an item card that can be dragged onto a character, like critical wounds. Turn off for the system's plain text result.
WFAM.Settings.ItemType.Name: Miscast item type
WFAM.Settings.ItemType.Hint: Item type used for miscast results. Injury lists them under Injuries on the Effects tab and supports a duration; Psychology lists them under Psychology.
WFAM.Card.DragHint: Drag this card onto a character to apply the miscast.
WFAM.Card.Manual: No automation for this result: apply it manually.
WFAM.Effect.NoCastingToast: Power Drain: you cannot cast or channel spells right now.
WFAM.Auto.Redirect: Roll again with the table link above
